#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
const int MOD = 1000000007;

int add_mod(int a, int b) {
    a += b;
    if (a >= MOD) a -= MOD;
    return a;
}

int multiply_mod(int a, int b) {
    long long res = 1LL * a * b;
    if (res >= MOD) res %= MOD;
    return (int)res;
}

int subtract_mod(int a, int b) {
    a -= b;
    if (a < 0) a += MOD;
    return a;
}

int power_mod(int base, int exp) {
    int result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = multiply_mod(result, base);
        base = multiply_mod(base, base);
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int low_bit(int x) {
    return x & (-x);
}

int n, a[10][10], ch[70010][128], idcnt = 0, q[10][128], dp[10][70010];
unordered_map<bitset<128>, int> id;

int dfs(bitset<128> s) {
    if (id.find(s) != id.end()) return id[s];
    id[s] = ++idcnt;
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
        bitset<128> tmp = s;
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
            if (!tmp[j]) {
                int x = i & j;
                while (x) {
                    int t = low_bit(x);
                    if (s[j ^ t]) {
                        tmp[j] = 1;
                        break;
                    }
                    x -= t;
                }
            }
        }
        ch[id[s]][i] = dfs(tmp);
    }
    return id[s];
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    dfs(1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            scanf("%d", &a[i][j]);
            a[i][j] = multiply_mod(a[i][j], power_mod(100, MOD - 2));
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
            q[i][j] = 1;
            for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                if ((j >> k) & 1) q[i][j] = multiply_mod(q[i][j], a[i][k]);
                else q[i][j] = multiply_mod(q[i][j], subtract_mod(1, a[i][k]));
            }
        }
    }
    dp[0][1] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= idcnt; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < (1 << n); k++) {
                dp[i][ch[j][k]] = add_mod(dp[i][ch[j][k]], multiply_mod(dp[i - 1][j], q[i - 1][k]));
            }
        }
    }
    bitset<128> bt;
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) bt[i] = 1;
    printf("%d\n", dp[n][id[bt]]);
    return 0;
}
